visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace a script with attributes
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A script checks the length of the name when the form is submitted. The browser can do this with the required and pattern attributes. Remove the script, keeping the same rule: at least 3 characters.

solution.explanation: The browser already knows how to block a form that has a wrong value and to show a message for it. required and pattern do this without code, work before the script has loaded and are easier to read.

checks.label: A two-letter nick is not accepted
checks.expr: (() => { type('#nick', 'ab'); var blocked = !el('#f').checkValidity() || submit('#f'); return blocked; })()
